subject.title: fix(tts): defer text settlement for final-mode TTS to eliminate churn (#83511)

question: Should OpenClaw adopt `capabilities.tts.voice.captionedFinalText` as the permanent plugin contract for channels that bundle final TTS text into voice-note captions?
rationale: The bug is established and the implementation is plausible, but this choice expands the plugin API and makes core suppress streaming text for every future channel that opts in; code correctness alone cannot decide that contract.

options.title: Approve the generic capability
options.body: Keep the opt-in channel contract and merge after rebase plus exact-head Telegram proof covers success, media, tagged mode, and fallback.

options.title: Keep the policy Telegram-owned
options.body: Avoid expanding the plugin contract and implement the behavior through a Telegram-owned seam, accepting less reuse.

options.title: Pause for broader TTS policy
options.body: Defer this PR until captioned versus separate text-and-voice delivery is decided alongside https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/42539.

recommendation.title: Approve the generic capability
recommendation.body: Keep the opt-in channel contract and merge after rebase plus exact-head Telegram proof covers success, media, tagged mode, and fallback.

likelyOwner.reason: His major ACP final-delivery refactors and recent work on the central dispatcher make him the best-supported owner for the core contract choice.
